I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. Its content rests entirely on the library's own definitions: `HopfIdeal`, `HopfIdeal.conjugate`, `IsBorelCandidate`, `IsBorelOverAlgClosed` and `FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat`. Mathlib has no notion of Borel Hopf ideals or of conjugating them by k-points, so no declaration there could state this.

The proof uses only the library's own lemmas, `isBorelOverAlgClosed_iff_exists_eq_conjugate` and `conjugate_mul`, plus group arithmetic. I did not run a separate search of Mathlib, because none of its declarations mention these library-specific concepts.
